# DACH Home & Body

> Luxury home fragrance, natural skincare, and curated gift services based in Abuja, Nigeria.

DACH Home & Body is a premium Nigerian lifestyle brand that handcrafts scented candles, reed diffusers, natural body oils, body butter, body scrubs, and gift boxes. All products are made in small batches with natural ingredients and delivered across Nigeria, with same-day delivery in Abuja.

## About the Brand

- **Founded**: Abuja, Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria
- **Owner**: Adacha B. Dzarma
- **Contact**: +234 809 900 7999 | support@dachhomeandbody.com
- **Website**: https://www.dachhomeandbody.com
- **Currency**: Nigerian Naira (₦)
- **Delivery**: Same-day in Abuja; 3–5 business days nationwide

## Product Categories

- **Home Fragrance** — Scented candles, reed diffusers, room sprays, wax melts, fragrance oils
- **Body Oil** — Nourishing body oils for all skin types
- **Body Wash** — Luxury body washes and aromatherapy formulas
- **Body Butter** — Rich, moisturising body butters in various scents
- **Body Scrub** — Sugar scrubs and skin treatments
- **Massage Oil** — Therapeutic massage oils
- **Hand Wash & Lotion** — Gentle hand care
- **Gift Sets** — Curated luxury gift boxes for any occasion
- **Gift Box Builder** — Custom gift boxes assembled from any products

## What Makes DACH Different

- All products handcrafted in small batches
- Natural ingredients, no harsh chemicals
- Same-day delivery across Abuja
- "Let Someone Else Pay" feature — share a payment link for someone to buy on your behalf
- Custom gift boxes with personalised messages, ribbon colours, and card styles
- Elegant luxury packaging, gift-ready always

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What products does DACH Home & Body sell?**
Luxury scented candles, reed diffusers, natural body oils, body butter, body scrubs, bath products, and curated gift boxes.

**Where does DACH Home & Body deliver?**
Nationwide across Nigeria. Same-day delivery is available in Abuja (FCT). Other locations receive delivery in 3–5 business days.

**Are DACH products natural?**
Yes. All products are formulated with naturally derived ingredients, made in small batches without unnecessary harsh additives.

**How long do DACH candles burn?**
Approximately 50–60 hours for the 250g candle and 90–100 hours for the 450g candle, depending on care and burning conditions.

**Can I send a gift without paying myself?**
Yes. DACH offers a "Let Someone Else Pay" feature — you build your cart and generate a shareable link. The link recipient pays and the order ships to your address.

**What payment methods are accepted?**
Paystack and Flutterwave — cards, bank transfer, and USSD.

**Is DACH Home & Body available internationally?**
Currently delivering within Nigeria only.
